name: ChatBlazer
description_en:
ChatBlazer is a product in the Live chat category. Its directory profile covers Video Chat, Shortcut Messages, Persistent Chat, Knowledge Database, Co-Browsing.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large). API support is listed as NA. Support channels are listed as Business Hours, Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Not Available Starts at $80.0.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: communicate through live video. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
